Clause (A), "relevant": printed "A member of G is relevant at a polygon P if it is unconditional, or if it is conditional and active at P". Lean (996-997) `Generic P := IsPolygon P ∧ ∀ m : Member n, m.Relevant P → m.eval P ≠ 0`, with `IsPolygon P := ∀ i, edge P i ≠ 0` (47) = "p_{i+1} ≠ p_i for every i". The printed "equivalently" sentence is the field `generic_iff` (1227-1229), and "We write U_n" is `genericLocus n := {P | Generic P}` (1000) with field `locus`.

Member index type (618-623) vs printed side conditions: `g2 (e i) (h : i ≠ e ∧ i ≠ e + 1)` = "every $i\notin\{e,e+1\}$" (guarded excerpt 13-14); `g5 (e f) (h : remote e f ∧ rep e < rep f)` = "every pair of remote edge indices with $1\leq e<f\leq n$" (60-61); `g3 … (remote e f ∧ remote f g ∧ remote e g ∧ rep e < rep f ∧ rep f < rep g)` = "every triple of pairwise remote edges $1\leq e<f<g\leq n$" (77); `g4 … (remote e f ∧ remote e g ∧ f ≠ g ∧ rep f < rep g)` = "every edge $e$ and every pair of edges remote to $e$ with $1\leq f<g\leq n$" (89-90).

Activation (654-659): `.g5 e f _ => Crosses P e f`; `.g3 e f g _ => Crosses P e f ∧ Crosses P f g ∧ Crosses P e g`; `.g4 e f g _ => Crosses P e f ∧ Crosses P e g` ↔ printed "active when $e$ and $f$ cross" (67-68), "active when $e,f,g$ pairwise cross" (78), "active when $f$ and $g$ both cross $e$" (92-93). `Crosses` (382-383) `remote e f ∧ G2 P e f * G2 P e (f + 1) < 0 ∧ G2 P f e * G2 P f (e + 1) < 0` ↔ printed "$\mathrm{G2}_{e,f}\,\mathrm{G2}_{e,f+1}<0 \quad\text{and}\quad \mathrm{G2}_{f,e}\,\mathrm{G2}_{f,e+1}<0$" (18-22).

Printed (B): "A \emph{chamber} is a connected component of the set $\mathcal U_n$ of generic polygons" ↔ Lean 1004-1005 `def chamber (P : LabelledTuple n) : Set (LabelledTuple n) := connectedComponentIn (genericLocus n) P`; Mathlib Topology/Connected/Basic.lean 505-506: `noncomputable def connectedComponentIn (F : Set α) (x : α) : Set α := if h : x ∈ F then (↑) '' connectedComponent (⟨x, h⟩ : F) else ∅`. Bundle field 1242 `(¬ Generic P → chamber P = ∅)`; connectedness and membership only under `Generic P` (1241).

Bench-A witness (sm-1-polygons.tex 555: `((0,0),(8,-11),(2,0),(5,-9),(-7,0),(6,-11))`) evaluated exactly with the Lean formulas: all G1_i ≠ 0, all G2_{e,i} ≠ 0 (i ∉ {e,e+1}); strict-sign active pairs (0,2) [G2s = 22,−17,−18,21; det = −39] and (3,5) [G2s = 15,−63,−1,77; det = −78]; no active g3/g4 members; remote pair (1,5) has det = 0 but G2s = (22,22,−22,−22) so inactive. => CV.Generic TRUE. SM (G1) fails on vertex triple (0,2,4) (collinear (0,0),(2,0),(−7,0)) => SM.Generic FALSE, as the status note says ("strictly weaker than the genericity stated here from n=6 on").

Bow-tie ((0,0),(2,2),(2,0),(0,2)): active pair (0,2) only; remote pair (1,3) det = 0, G2s = (−4,−4,4,4) inactive; CV.Generic TRUE — matches rem:fidelity (d1_setup.tex 299-303) that the pinned bow-tie "has two parallel remote edges that do not meet" and stays generic only because (G5) is conditional.

Wall-point polygon ((0,0),(4,0),(5,3),(2,0),(1,3),(-1,1)): unconditional G2_(0,3) = 0, no active pairs => non-generic under both readings, matching guarded excerpt 52-53 "Such a configuration is not generic --- those vanishing members are unconditional, hence relevant".

SM primitives used: Polygon.lean 13-16 `abbrev Plane := ℝ × ℝ`, `abbrev LabelledTuple (n : ℕ) := ZMod n → Plane`, `def det (u v : Plane) : ℝ := u.1 * v.2 - u.2 * v.1`; 49 `def edge P i := P (i + 1) - P i`; 63-66 `adjacent i j := j - i = -1 ∨ j - i = 0 ∨ j - i = 1`, `remote i j := ¬ adjacent i j`; Generic.lean 11-19 `SM.Generic P := G1 P ∧ G2 P` (all-triple chirotope + no three edge interiors concurrent) — used only in the one-directional bridge `of_sm` (1248), never to narrow `CV.Generic`.

`rep` (317) `def rep [NeZero n] (i : ZMod n) : ℕ := (i - 1).val + 1`: rep 0 = n, rep k = k for 1 ≤ k ≤ n−1 = printed "unique integer in $\{1,\dots,n\}$ naming that edge" (guarded excerpt 99-100); the representative order does not affect genericity (G5_swap 407, G4_swap 410, crosses_comm 460).

n < 3: `Generic` is false for n = 1 (edge P 0 = P 0 − P 0 = 0, so IsPolygon fails) and n = 2 (G1 P 0 = det(edge P 1, edge P 0) = det(−d, d) = 0, an unconditional member), so `genericLocus n = ∅` where the printed $\mathcal U_n$ (n ≥ 3 per def:polygon) is undefined — an extension, not a narrowing.
